Format diff values as HTML with separate arrow and value spans

Source: R/track_wkflow_formattable.R
dot-diff_display_html.Rd

Returns a list of htmltools::HTML() objects so that nested <span> elements are rendered without escaping. The arrow uses arrow_size and the value uses value_size, allowing the arrow to be larger than the number.

Usage

.diff_display_html(diffs, arrow_size = 1, value_size = 0.7, big_mark = " ")

Arguments

diffs

Numeric vector of differences.

arrow_size

Font-size multiplier (em) for the arrow.

value_size

Font-size multiplier (em) for the value text.

big_mark

Character used to group digits every 3 places.

Value

A list of htmltools::HTML objects.
